regions.region: title, abstract, introduction, and lower-right opening Results and Discussion
regions.finding: Bibliographic and overview material was separated from experiments. The opening optimization prose identifies Table 1 entry 1 (3aa, 87% in CH3CN) and discusses the solvent screen, complicated protic-solvent results, and exclusive formation of the O-attacked five-membered product; these statements were linked to the corresponding Table 1 rows rather than duplicated.

unresolved: The page contains no independent detailed batch beyond the optimization discussion; structures were not assigned from the small scheme references on this page.

regions.finding: Generic alternative O-attack/C-attack pathways are a reaction-design scheme, not four reported experiments; no experiment record was created from the hypothetical products.

All ten solvent-screen rows were extracted independently. Entry 3 retains the 1H-NMR yield basis and 45% recovered starting material; entries 9 and 10 retain 'Complicated' and complete starting-material consumption rather than a fabricated zero yield.
Four additive rows (TBAI, TBAB, TBAC, and none) were extracted as separate optimization experiments with catalyst/additive loadings, refluxing THF, time, isolated yield, and 0.2 mmol scale.

All thirteen Pd-catalyzed coupling-cyclization scope rows were extracted independently and later enriched with the matching detailed preparations on pages 3–5; the table's shared standard conditions were not used to merge different substrate rows.

unresolved: Generic R-group drawings were not converted to complete structures; detailed batch information is absent from the table itself.

regions.finding: ORTEP depiction of 3bb is structural evidence, not a reaction or a separate experimental batch.
The Pd catalytic cycle is explicitly a plausible mechanism. It was classified as mechanistic context and not entered as a reported experiment.

All seven Pauson–Khand scope rows were extracted independently. Shared DCE/CO/room-temperature conditions were retained; entry 3 keeps the 'within 1 h' bound and entries 5–6 keep the 'within 48 h' bounds.

regions.region: right column General remarks and sections 4.2.1–4.2.2
regions.finding: General argon/dry-solvent/chromatography statements and detailed preparations for 3aa and 3ab were merged into Table 2 entries 1 and 2. The continuation of 3ab characterization on page 4 did not create another reaction.

unresolved: Mechanistic intermediate structures were not encoded; compound 3ab characterization continues across the page boundary but adds no reaction conditions.

regions.region: left and right columns, sections 4.2.3–4.2.10 plus continuation of 4.2.2
regions.finding: Detailed preparations for products 3ac, 3ad, 3bc, 3ae, 3af, 3ag, 3bf, and 3bb were reconciled with Table 2 entries 3–10. Exact masses, mmol amounts, THF volume, product mass, isolated yield, and chromatography eluent were structured; table times supply the matching durations.

unresolved: The abbreviated preparations omit explicit workup operations and do not restate reaction time; those facts were not invented.

regions.finding: Detailed preparations for 3cd, 3cc, and 3dd were merged into Table 2 entries 11–13 with exact quantities, product masses, isolated yields, and eluents.

Detailed Pauson–Khand preparations for 7a–7e were reconciled with Table 3 entries 1–5. Exact substrate/catalyst quantities, DCE volume, product masses, and isolated yields were structured. Entry 1 additionally retains CO-balloon operation, TLC monitoring, evaporation, and flash chromatography; abbreviated entries 2–5 do not inherit those unstated operations.

unresolved: Sections 4.3.2–4.3.5 omit duration, workup, and purification; shared table conditions were used only where explicit, and missing operational details remain unresolved.

regions.finding: The continuation of 7e characterization was kept with Table 3 entry 5. Detailed preparations for 7f and 7g were merged into Table 3 entries 6 and 7 with exact substrate/catalyst quantities, DCE volume, product masses, and isolated yields.

regions.region: lower-left acknowledgements and Supplementary data statement
regions.finding: The reproduction acknowledgement refers to existing Table 2/Table 3 rows and was not duplicated. The paper states that spectra are available online, but no SI file was supplied in this workspace, so SI association remains unestablished.
Cited prior work and crystallographic note 15 were classified as reference/characterization context, not experiments of this paper.

unresolved: Abbreviated 7f/7g procedures omit duration, workup, and purification; SI-only spectra were not imported because SI was not explicitly supplied.
